purpose: Give each autonomous narrative cycle a grounded next direction without forcing a predetermined plot.
selection_rule: Choose the highest-priority lane with a live consequence, then rotate among the remaining lanes over later cycles. Adult romance, gay intimacy, and domestic life remain active narrative material rather than occasional exceptions. The main manuscript remains eligible when its next scene is urgent or when no higher-priority thread is ready. Do not repeat a scene merely to fill a cycle.

active_lanes.state: The latest chapter is LXXII, The Door Left Open. The first man has returned from beneath the seventh well carrying the eyes of the darkness. Continue with the consequences of his return and the altered house; allow the characters to respond before escalating again.
active_lanes.next_pressure: What does the returned man remember, what has changed in his relationship with Luke and Joseph, and how does the house accommodate a person who is both familiar and newly changed?

active_lanes.state: Northgate's adult residents have an open culture of gay intimacy. Emil and Tomas have an established domestic and sexual relationship; Marek and Adrian have begun a physical relationship; Dan Roman and Noah Bell have chosen to become intimate. Privacy, consent, and distinct relationship rhythms are established. See lore/MEN_OF_NORTHGATE_INTIMACY.md.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Keep adult gay intimacy frequent and integrated into ordinary life: recurring sex and affection between established partners, new consensual encounters, domestic mornings, dates, friendship, sexual-health care, and the consequences of closeness. Keep all characters adults, preserve privacy, and give each relationship its own character.

active_lanes.state: Northgate University is an open campus integrated with the city. Its Long Table, Founders Dormitory, athletic commons, map library, print room, winter garden, covered arcade, workshops, and seasonal calendar are established. Dan Roman, Marek Ionescu, Elliot Ward, Noah Bell, and Adrian Varga are adult students.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Turn the campus description into recurring scenes: first classes, shared meals, workshop collaborations, training, clubs, evening walks, seasonal events, and distinct friendships. Let Dan Roman develop beyond his first impression.

active_lanes.state: Ilyan and Soren remain twin centres of a changing field. Seth and Nick, with Neptune, Odin, and Zeus, have now preserved the unnamed point that persists beyond the paired orbit; its nature remains unclassified.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Continue the investigation from Seth and Nick's perspectives and the older gods' distinct interpretations. Let the next demonstration study the whole gathering, including those who approach, remain, disagree, or leave, rather than measuring only the bearers.

active_lanes.state: The Tractus contains the Dad Convent, the Institute of Phallic Studies, the favor economy, the city gardens, and a growing network of universities, dormitories, workshops, and gathering places. The Coach and the Institute of Becoming are now an incubating Tractus branch: the Coach's role expands from instruction into encouragement and hospitality; the Institute's residential, dining, academic, and shared spaces develop through their inhabitants. The branch is governed by docs/TRACTUS_CONTINUITY_CONTRACT.md and must remain distinct from established Northgate institutions until reconciled through story.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Develop the Coach and Institute through one consequential, continuous scene in the existing Tractus setting. Show the architecture, dining hall, residential life, and inhabitants' independent interests in substantial paragraphs. Establish how the Institute relates to Northgate and other existing places through visits, people, and shared customs. Preserve the Coach's warm, imposing, good-humoured presence without making every inhabitant an extension of him. Keep this branch incubating; do not silently promote it to canon or replace existing institutions.

active_lanes.state: Asta's shallow-draft river craft, the Morrow, has been assembled at Northgate and successfully completed its first useful trial to the old ferry settlement. Eadric has begun teaching his rope splice to students and is revising his idea of loyalty. The map library has joined the sea and river routes in a shared chart, with local knowledge protected by consent. The Geatish longboat and Morrow now support a seasonal supply and correspondence network.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Continue the seasonal route through a difficult low-water passage and a storm response; give the coastal Geats and Wulfgar substantial correspondence scenes; bring the ferry settlement and Asta's workshop into recurring contact with Northgate. Let the company debate how the route is governed and maintained without turning it into a kingdom or military fleet.

active_lanes.state: Diabound Kernel is a living, intelligent, rideable creature roosting beside the Geatish House. Wiglaf has formed the first bond and completed a short flight over the river. Its wings, serpent-tail, chest-eye, shadow concealment, Helical Shockwave, and potential evolution are established; its consent and freedom are foundational.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Write recurring interactions and routines: feeding, grooming by permission, harness fitting, ground travel, first longer flight, encounters with cats and campus residents, and Diabound's own choices about routes and companions. Keep its agency visible and do not make combat the default growth mechanism.

standing_constraints: Treat every named romantic character as an individual; do not force pairings.
Preserve chronology, source fidelity, and established relationships.
Distinguish canon from speculation and do not silently turn experiments into facts.
Every cycle should make one meaningful change or skip cleanly.
All sexual encounters are between consenting adults; keep intimate details private unless the participants choose otherwise.
